name: Coinnect
description: Open money transfer routing engine. Finds the cheapest path to send money between any two currencies — fiat, crypto, and P2P — across 80+ adapters worldwide.

schemes.description: No key required. Rate-limited to 20 requests/day per IP.
Free API key via POST /v1/keys — no signup, no email. 1,000 req/day, 100 req/hour.
schemes.name: X-Api-Key

skills.name: Quote
skills.description: Find the cheapest routes to send money between two currencies. Returns ranked routes with fees, times, and step-by-step instructions.
examples: How much does it cost to send 500 USD to MXN?
Find the cheapest way to send 1000 EUR to NGN

from_currency.description: Source currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, BTC)

to_currency.description: Destination currency code (e.g. MXN, NGN, BRL)

amount.description: Amount to send in source currency (e.g. 500)

skills.name: Corridors
skills.description: List all supported currency pairs (corridors) with available providers and transfer methods.
examples: What currency pairs does Coinnect support?

skills.name: Explain Route
skills.description: Get a plain-language explanation of a money transfer route — what happens at each step, fees, and estimated time.
examples: Explain this USD to MXN route via Binance and Bitso

route.description: Route description or label to explain

skills.name: Verify Rate
skills.description: Report a real exchange rate you observed at a provider. Helps Coinnect calibrate estimated rates toward real-world values.
examples: I see USD/MXN at 17.45 on Wise right now

provider.description: Provider name where you observed the rate

skills.name: Quests
skills.description: List open rate verification bounties — corridors where Coinnect needs real rate data from the community.
examples: What rate verification quests are open?
Show me bounties I can claim

skills.name: Payment Route
skills.description: Pick the optimal MPP (Machine Payment Protocol, mpp.dev) method for an agent-to-API transaction. Coinnect /v1/quote accepts MPP with Tempo USDC (micropayments, $0.0001/req) and optionally Stripe (card, $1.00/req). Free tier remains for low-volume use.
examples: What's the cheapest way to pay $0.0001 for a quote?
Best MPP method for streaming quote calls

amount_usd.description: Payment amount in USD (e.g. 0.0001 for a Tempo micropayment, 1.00 for Stripe)

frequency.description: Payment frequency: one-off, session, or streaming

available_methods.description: Agent's available payment methods: usdc_tempo, fiat_card, free_tier. Legacy 'usdc_base' is treated as usdc_tempo.

recipient_accepts.description: What the server accepts: mpp, free_tier. Legacy 'x402' is treated as mpp.

methods.network_note: Tempo Moderato testnet — mainnet (4217) when ready
